const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"/tmp/pumpmodem-cleanup-venv/bin/python -B - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'../tools')
from triad_dynamic_joint import BlockProjection
w=json.loads(Path('../fixturedata/projection-workload.json').read_text())
p=BlockProjection.make(w['samples'],w['sample_rate_hz'],w['required_bands_hz'],w['excluded_bands_hz'])
rng=np.random.default_rng(24091)
for dtype in (np.int16,np.float32,np.float64,np.complex64,np.complex128):
    x=(rng.normal(size=(3,64))+1j*rng.normal(size=(3,64))).astype(dtype) if np.dtype(dtype).kind=='c' else rng.normal(size=(3,64)).astype(dtype)
    actual=p.numpy(x)
    expected=np.fft.fft(x,axis=-1,norm='ortho')[...,p.indices]
    np.testing.assert_allclose(actual,expected,rtol=2e-14,atol=2e-14)
    assert actual.shape==expected.shape and actual.dtype==expected.dtype
    print(dtype.__name__, 'shape',actual.shape,'dtype',actual.dtype,'max_abs_error',float(np.max(np.abs(actual-expected))))
# Preserve fallback behavior when selected rows are not exactly singleton DC.
q=BlockProjection.make(64,64,((-1.,1.),))
x=rng.normal(size=(2,64))+1j*rng.normal(size=(2,64))
np.testing.assert_array_equal(q.numpy(x),np.fft.fft(x,axis=-1,norm='ortho')[...,q.indices])
print('multi-bin FFT fallback: exact array equality')
PY","workdir":"/tmp/delegation-recovery-runs/v203/workspace/tests","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":2000});
